create.name: Mark Zelinsky
create.bio:
Mark Zelinsky is a meditation teacher based in Ashland, Massachusetts, who began recording guided practices after years of his own sitting and reading in spiritual philosophy. He draws on several traditions, with early Buddhist teaching at the centre: his material works through the four foundations of mindfulness, the five spiritual faculties, the divine abodes of kindness and compassion, and readings from the Dhammapada and the suttas, alongside occasional texts from the Bible and the Hermetic writings. A love of the natural world and a plain, honest way of living run through much of what he says.

On Insight Timer he has built up three multi-day courses since 2018 and hosts regular free live sessions, part guided sitting and part open discussion, supported by a group where regulars keep talking between events. He keeps an archive of replays and downloadable meditations of many lengths on his website, writes Dharma Ramblings on Substack, and records songs as well. For those who want more personal guidance he offers one-to-one conversations about meditation practice and its application in daily life, and he leads group sittings and discussions either in person or online.

courses.title: One-to-one meditation guidance with Mark Zelinsky
courses.description: Personal conversations with Mark about your meditation practice, how its principles carry into everyday life, and related questions of thought and practice. He also leads group sittings with discussion, in person or online; get in touch through the form to arrange either.

courses.title: Taming The Mind: An Overview Of Meditation Practice And Theory
courses.description: A three-day Insight Timer course that walks through why we meditate and how, combining short teachings with guided practice. A good starting point for newcomers or anyone wanting to refresh the basics.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Exploring Mindfulness & The Divine Abodes
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course on mindfulness and the four Buddhist heart qualities of kindness, compassion, appreciative joy and equanimity. Each day pairs a talk with a guided sitting.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Mark Zelinsky on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Mark's guided meditations, readings of wisdom texts and recordings of his live sessions, many rooted in early Buddhist practice. Free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Guided meditations to download
free_resources.description: Mark's home page collects his meditations by length, from one-minute practices to longer sittings on breath, body, kindness and the awakening factors, with free audio files to save.

free_resources.title: Insight Timer Live audio archive
free_resources.description: Lightly edited recordings of Mark's free live sessions, covering themes such as karma, the eightfold path, letting go and good will. Details of upcoming live events are on the same page.

free_resources.title: Dharma Ramblings with Mark Z
free_resources.description: Mark's Substack of essays, talks and replays on applied religion and spirituality, and on how these topics lead back into meditation and contemplation. Free to subscribe.
